title: Your Profile
content: Your Profile is where you manage your personal details, raise and track support requests, and set your notification preferences, all in one place.

title: Open Profile
content: Click your profile card to open the profile page.

title: Basic Information
content: This section holds your core identity on the platform, including name, email, role, and phone number. Keep it accurate so alerts and team communications always reach the right person.

title: First Name
content: Your first name as it appears across the platform, in alert logs, audit records, and team communications.

title: Last Name
content: Your last name. Combined with your first name, this forms the identity shown to other team members throughout the system.

title: Email Address
content: Your registered work email is read-only because it is tied to your account credentials and can only be changed by your administrator.

title: Role
content: The assigned role determines access levels and feature availability across the platform (such as User, Manager, or Admin). These permissions are managed centrally by your hospital administrator.

title: Phone Number
content: Your contact number is optional, but worth adding so your team can reach you directly for urgent escalations outside the platform.

title: Edit Profile
content: Click Edit Profile to unlock your name and phone fields. Email and role stay read-only, as they are managed by your administrator.

title: Edit Your Details
content: Your name and phone number fields are now editable. Email and role remain locked, as they are managed at the account level by your administrator.

title: Save Changes
content: Click Save to commit your changes. The form validates inputs before saving. Names must contain letters only, and phone numbers must be a valid format.

title: Support Activity
content: The Support Activity panel displays all support tickets you have submitted, including bug reports and feature requests. It allows you to monitor their resolution status and post follow-up comments directly from your profile.

title: Submit New Request
content: Click Submit New Request to open the support form, pre-filled with your name and email, so you can raise a ticket without re-entering your details.

title: Full Name
content: Your full name is pulled from your profile and locked — every ticket is automatically attributed to the correct person.

title: Work Email
content: Your registered email is pre-filled and read-only. The support team will reply to this address when they respond to your ticket.

title: Type of Feedback
content: Choosing the feedback type (such as Bug, Feature Request, or Data Quality) helps the platform route your ticket to the correct support team immediately.

title: Subject
content: Entering a clear and descriptive subject helps the support team quickly identify, prioritize, and locate the issue you are reporting.

title: Detailed Description
content: Describe what happened, what you expected, and include any relevant tank or shipment IDs. The more detail you provide, the faster the support team can reproduce and resolve the issue.

title: Priority
content: Selecting a priority level defines the urgency of your request. Critical priority is reserved for issues actively impacting patient safety or live lab operations.

title: Affected Modules
content: Specifying the affected platform modules informs the engineering team exactly which area of the system is impacted so they can investigate.

title: Agreement & Submit
content: Check the agreement box to confirm you consent to being contacted about your ticket. The Submit button stays disabled until this box is ticked.

title: Submit Feedback
content: Click Submit Feedback to send your ticket to the myGrape support team. You'll land on a confirmation page showing your ticket ID, so keep it for any follow-up.

title: Ticket Submitted!
content: Your support ticket has been submitted. The myGrape team will review it and respond to your registered email within 24 hours.

title: Your Ticket ID
content: Save this ticket ID, which appears in your Support Activity list and is your reference number for any follow-up with the support team.

title: Back to Profile
content: Click Go to Profile to return to your profile page, where the ticket you just submitted will appear in your Support Activity list.

title: Your Tickets
content: Your submitted ticket now appears here. All tickets are listed, showing Ticket ID, title, type, and current status.

title: Ticket ID
content: Each ticket gets a unique ID like TK-2026-04-001 on creation. Use this ID when following up with support so they can pull up your request instantly.

title: Ticket Status
content: Tickets move through three stages: Open → In Review → Resolved. Track progress here without needing to contact support separately.

title: Ticket Type
content: Each ticket is categorised by type, such as Bug Report, Feature Request, or General Query, so the right team picks it up immediately.

title: View Ticket Details
content: Click any row to open the full ticket to read the complete description, view support team comments, and add your own follow-up notes.

title: Notifications
content: Control how the platform communicates with you. Changes here only affect your account, and other users' preferences remain unchanged.

title: Ticket Update Emails
content: Turn this on to receive an email whenever one of your support ticket statuses changes, which is useful if you want updates without checking the platform manually.

title: Feature Update Emails
content: Stay informed about new myGrape features and product improvements. This option is coming soon, and once live, you'll receive periodic feature update newsletters.
